evidence: Modifies accepted socket configuration for inbound peer connections in src/net.cpp
rationale: Hardens inbound P2P socket handling against potential thread stalls by explicitly setting non-blocking mode on accepted sockets. While there is no current vulnerability because POSIX calls explicitly pass MSG_DONTWAIT, author notes that relying solely on per-call flags risks allowing 'a malicious peer to stall us indefinitely for free' if a flag is ever omitted.
